name: MUDDY WATERS, HIGH RISES
clue: Its name means 'muddy confluence' in Malay, and its twin Petronas Towers were the world's tallest buildings from 1998 to 2004

name: AN ILL WIND FOR KUBLAI
clue: Japanese for 'divine wind', this word was given to the typhoons said to have wrecked two Mongol invasion fleets in the 1200s

name: LAST STOP
clue: In 1910, at 82, this author of an epic of Napoleon's invasion fled his estate and died days later at a remote railway station

name: SEA LEVEL, NOT
clue: Fossils of ancient sea creatures are locked in the limestone that forms the very top of this peak
